resources.string: Show the code from a new verification SMS on the toolbar; tap it to type. Needs the SMS permission. Codes stay on this phone and are never sent anywhere.
When a 6–8 digit code is copied (e.g. the TOTP that Bitwarden copies after autofill), offer it on the toolbar like an SMS code
When the current field looks like a code field, type a code received or copied within the last minute automatically (once)
SMS permission granted; new verification codes will appear on the toolbar
